rows.text: PIB's release of 13 October 1999 ('Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee - a profile') reports that Vajpayee has been sworn in as the Prime Minister of India, the President, K. R. Narayanan, having administered the oath of office and secrecy in the forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhawan 'here today'.

rows.text: The same release says Vajpayee 'has assumed the august office of the Prime Minister of India for the third time'.

rows.text: The same release says Vajpayee was earlier Prime Minister of India 'from May 16-31, 1996 and a second time from March 19, 1998 till date'.
